item.title: Pavement blocked... again, 18th August
item.description:
The bins, combined with the bike padlocked to the lamp post, blocked the pavement such that I had trouble getting past as an able bodied, sighted person. Quite sad for anyone who isn't. Walk into, trip over, fall pain, not nice. The bins can go in the suitably large, able bodied owners garden though. Why don't they? Perhaps enforce Southwark Council's policy on pavements...

item.title: Entire road of Allington Road, 18th August
item.description:
The entire hedges/bushes along Allington Road are overgrown and need cutting back along the wall. People are fly tipping rubbish into the bushes because it hides it all. This is also causing a pest problem which is not fair on residents due to other people dumping their rubbish. It’s evident there is a fly tipping problem on Allington Road and cutting back the hedges will help solve the issue of dumping rubbish.
Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Allington Road, London

item.title: Pavement blocked by commercial shelving units, 18th August
item.description:
Large commercial shelving units are being permanently installed in an already narrow and extremely crowded section of the pavement by a bus stop obstructing the way for people. This is significantly reducing the amount of space for people to move through especially those with mobility difficulties. Please investigate what planning permission was issued for this to be installed.
